# #901/#904 capacity-hold corpus, read by the engine (dispatch::tests) and the ah-hook launcher (edge_cases) so both matchers are
# held to the same table. One case per line: "H <command>" must be held, "P <command>" must pass. A literal \n in a command is a
# newline. A held case that passes is a fail-open: the test fails.
# "R <command>" was held before #969 and passes now: an unknown command name that names nothing risky (unknown.risky_only:
# held only when the command matches script.risky, so `zzalias920 push` stays held). It turns back into H if that switch is 0.
# "R <command>" was held by a rule #969 switched off under load (only the irreversible classes stay held: push, git destroy, gh
# remote change, recursive delete, deploy, publish, money, eFuse, dropped rows; no dynamic-command, pipe-to-shell, heredoc,
# inline-code, unknown-name or unread-script hold): it must pass now, and turns back into H if such a rule is switched on again.
